**Business Scenario:**

This platform will aggregate and analyze data from universities worldwide to generate detailed rankings based on various performance metrics. The rankings will include indicators such as global rank, impact, openness, and excellence, which are essential for potential students, academic professionals, and policymakers.

The platform will cater to a wide range of users, including prospective students looking for universities, academic researchers conducting comparative studies, and university administrators seeking to understand their institution's standing and areas for improvement. Each university's profile will include detailed performance metrics, historical ranking data, and comparisons with peer institutions. The platform will also feature advanced search and filtering capabilities, allowing users to explore universities based on specific criteria such as country, discipline, and ranking factors. Additionally, the system will provide comprehensive reporting tools and visualizations to help users interpret and leverage the data effectively.

The platform will also support user management with roles and permissions tailored to different user types, including students, researchers, and administrators. It will facilitate collaboration and data sharing among users while ensuring data privacy and integrity.
